name: Release Deck
description: Prepare a video series, inspect clips and share a release plan.
features: Local video preview and frame capture
File reattachment checks and release preflight
Episode order, translations and planned times
Portable project files and a shareable release sheet
Private team review and owner approval
Private YouTube uploads and separate visibility actions after authorized setup
businessHypothesis: Creator teams may value larger private release capacity and a repeatable review-to-delivery workflow. The existing creator subscription supplies the actual combined saved-project allowance. Channel operations require service configuration and each creator's authorization. Customer demand, paid conversions and revenue remain unverified.
